name: Neighborhood Scoring & Ranking Engine
target_workflow: Area comparison and recommendation based on customer preferences (budget, commute, lifestyle, family structure).
proposed_ai_capability: LLM-powered multi-criteria decision engine that scores and ranks neighborhoods using structured area profiles, commute data, school ratings, and safety metrics.
expected_business_value: Reduces consultant time per case by 40-50%, ensures consistent recommendations across staff, speeds up onboarding for new consultants.
key_risk: Bias in scoring due to incomplete or outdated area data; overfitting to historical patterns.
human_approval_requirement: Consultant must review and optionally adjust rankings before presenting to customer.
required_data: Area profiles (safety, cost, schools, amenities, transport), commute time matrices, historical customer preference-resolution pairs.
japan_enterprise_fit: High – directly addresses labor productivity and consistency, aligns with DX and kaizen improvement culture.
evidence_support: OECD labour shortage report, METI GENIAC workflow efficiency case, FSA governance framework.
why_now: Scattered area info is a critical pain point; AI can unify data and reduce manual comparison as labor shortages intensify.

name: Multilingual Consultation Assistant
target_workflow: Handling inquiries from foreign customers who require clear explanations in English or Japanese.
proposed_ai_capability: Multilingual LLM (fine-tuned on real estate domain) that translates and clarifies customer requirements, explains area trade-offs, and generates culturally appropriate recommendations.
expected_business_value: Expands market to growing foreign resident segment, reduces dependency on bilingual staff, improves customer satisfaction and trust.
key_risk: Mistranslation or cultural miscommunication leading to mismatched expectations.
human_approval_requirement: Consultant reviews all AI-generated customer-facing text before sending; sensitive edges handled manually.
required_data: Multilingual area glossary, sample past interactions in English/Japanese, area notes with cultural context.
japan_enterprise_fit: High – addresses need to serve foreign residents, aligns with Digital Agency's push for inclusive digital services.
evidence_support: OECD labour shortage / skills gap, FSA customer convenience theme, METI GENIAC multimodal document processing case.
why_now: Increasing foreign resident population in Tokyo; existing Japanese-only workflow limits market reach and service quality.

name: Automated Area Knowledge Aggregator
target_workflow: Gathering and updating area information from multiple scattered sources into a unified profile.
proposed_ai_capability: RAG-based information retrieval system that crawls trusted sources, extracts and summarizes area characteristics, and updates a centralized knowledge base with version control.
expected_business_value: Eliminates hours of manual research per consultant per week; ensures all staff have access to latest, consistent area data.
key_risk: Outdated or incorrect information from unauthoritative sources; potential for hallucination in summaries.
human_approval_requirement: Curated list of approved sources; human review of new or flagged summaries before they go live.
required_data: Access to Japanese real estate portals, municipal websites, transport APIs, school district databases, and internal area notes.
japan_enterprise_fit: High – internal knowledge retrieval is a top AI use case in Japanese enterprises; fits kaizen philosophy of continuous data improvement.
evidence_support: METI GENIAC document processing case, IPA DX trends report on AI for knowledge work, FSA governance emphasis on data quality.
why_now: Scattered information is a direct pain point; manual aggregation is unsustainable given increasing volume and staff shortage.

name: AI-Enhanced Preference Elicitation Chatbot
target_workflow: Initial customer requirement gathering via web forms or chat.
proposed_ai_capability: Conversational AI that asks dynamic, clarifying questions based on initial inputs to refine preferences (budget, commute tolerance, family needs) before handing off to consultant.
expected_business_value: Cuts consultation prep time by 30%; reduces back-and-forth emails; captures nuanced requirements early.
key_risk: Poorly designed dialog flow may frustrate users or fail to capture critical constraints.
human_approval_requirement: Consultant reviews extracted preference summary and can manually adjust before proceeding.
required_data: Customer preference forms, historical chat/email logs, decision trees used by experienced consultants.
japan_enterprise_fit: Medium-high – fits service industry trend of AI-augmented customer interaction, but must handle Japanese politeness levels and indirect expressions carefully.
evidence_support: FSA customer convenience theme, OECD workplace AI productivity, METI GENIAC insurance contract case (document-based Q&A).
why_now: Diverse and time-consuming requirements are a top pain; early structuring of preferences reduces downstream inefficiencies.

name: Property Search Strategy Advisor
target_workflow: Translating area recommendations into actionable property search directions and trade-off explanations.
proposed_ai_capability: LLM agent that suggests search filters (price range, size, age) based on area characteristics and user budget, explains trade-offs (e.g., distance vs. price), and outputs a brief to guide human consultant's property search.
expected_business_value: Reduces trial-and-error property search by 35%; minimizes consultant time spent explaining basic trade-offs; ensures alignment with area-level insights.
key_risk: Oversimplification or overpromising on property availability; reliance on potentially biased listing data.
human_approval_requirement: Consultant finalizes search plan and approves any customer-facing explanations.
required_data: Current property listing samples, price-range trends per area, commute cost data, typical property sizes/ages.
japan_enterprise_fit: High – directly supports consultant workflow by bridging area advice and actual property search, with clear human-in-the-loop.
evidence_support: METI GENIAC workflow efficiency, OECD productivity improvement, FSA risk management for regulated-like processes.
why_now: Consultants spend too much time on repetitive search tasks; AI-guided strategy can standardize and accelerate the process.
